parameter: EIA 3.2 Noise, construction: noisy works (piling, blasting, steam blowing) only 07:00-19:00 weekdays and 08:00-17:00 Saturdays; steam blowing with 7 days' notice to the village and silencers
remarks: ALP-EPC-00000-HS-PLN-0003 (construction environmental and social management plan); ALP-EPC-00000-CM-CMP-0001 (steam blowing procedure); permit PMT-011.
value_text: The construction method statements and the schedule restrict piling, blasting and steam blowing to the permitted hours; steam blowing is planned with temporary silencers and a 7-day notice issued through the Owner; the construction noise assessment report is a permit item (PMT-011).
